slides.label: What you see
slides.html:
Every lap, every trace, every sector.

Lap time comparison

All laps in one ranked table, best lap highlighted, delta to fastest.

Speed trace overlay

See exactly where you gain or lose speed against another driver.

GPS track map

Your racing line, colour-coded slow to fast. Overlay drivers corner by corner.

Sector analysis

Three sectors, the fastest in each highlighted. Find the sector that costs you.
